That error behavior feels right. When I typed "not a link" and hit Save, it didn't create a bookmark and didn't throw away the save box — it kept it open with "not a link" still sitting in the field and a plain-English note telling me to enter a full web address including https://. So I can just fix what I typed right there instead of starting over, and I'm not left with a junk entry in my collection. That's the gentle, correct-in-place handling I'd want when I fumble a paste.

I'm happy with that. What's next?
